verdict.rationale: Customer.io ships its own agent (in-app and in Slack), so it could plausibly act as an MCP client that connects to external MCP servers; the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents Customer.io's own MCP server, which external AI tools connect to. That is the opposite (server) role. Nothing shows users can plug third-party MCP servers into Customer.io's agent so it can use their tools.
